text: A Protocol is defined similarly to a regular class, but it inherits from `typing.Protocol`.
Inside the `Climbable` Protocol, define the `climb` method, but you don't need to write the implementation. You can just use `...` (an ellipsis) or `pass` in the body.
When writing `Ladder` and `Mountain`, do not add `(Climbable)` to their class definitions. Just implement the methods. Mypy will check the structure automatically.
Make sure your type hints exactly match: `def climb(self, steps: int) -> bool:`
